occurrences.text: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
